title: Image viewer: a zoomable full-screen presentation
acceptance: A self-contained ImageViewer view presents an archived image full screen
Pinch to zoom, pan while zoomed, double-tap to toggle fit and fill
A caption renders beneath, visually secondary to body prose; no caption still looks right
It takes an already-archived image and never fetches from the network
It compiles and is previewable on its own, with no dependency on how the reader mounts it
notes: Part of 'reading is unpleasant'. The gallery half overlaps T-0028, which already covers img-inside-li extraction; this task owns the reading-side behaviour.
